Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up — ACME Retail triggered a usage-drop alert (42% token drop last 14d). Renewal in ~28 days. Thinking a 2-week 'education sprint' + soft commercial levers to avoid downgrade. Thoughts?
Ravi (AM): Thanks, Maya. Can you drop the key contacts and the main friction? We should coordinate tech + enablement. cc @Elena for finance/offer options.
Maya (CSM): Contacts: Tom (CTO), Priya (Product lead). Main friction: prefix/KV caching not enabled, they're seeing token spikes and some timeouts; they disabled a couple power-features to stabilize.
Noah (Support): I can do a 30-min tech deep-dive this week. Available Wed 10:00-10:30 PST. We'll need logs: batch_size, kv_cache_hits, tail_latency95. I'll also capture request traces.
Elena (CS Ops): :thumbsup: I can prep a 'save offer' (10% off next quarter if they commit to pilot + 3 enablement sessions). Want to try remediation + enablement first before commercial incentives?
Maya (CSM): Prefer soft path first. Proposed play: (1) Tech triage (Noah) — capture baseline metrics (2) Enablement workshop for power users (Maya) — hands-on prompts & best practices (3) 2-week nudges + tailored prompt library (Ravi) — measure adoption (4) Fallback: graceful downgrade path + pro-rated credits if no recovery.
Ravi (AM): I'll stand up a short feedback pulse (Typeform) to capture outcomes after the workshop. Also add a 7-day adoption check.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "ACME - Tech Triage" Wed 10:00-10:30 PST. Organizer: Noah (Support). Link: https://cal.link/abc123
Maya (CSM): Workshop sketch checklist:
```
- 15m: goal alignment & current workflows
- 30m: hands-on prompt tuning + cache settings review
- 15m: next steps, metrics & success criteria
```
Noah (Support): I'll bring logs and a quick config diff. Early recommendation: try `max_batch=16` and enable KV caching for long prefixes; we'll validate impact on `lat95`.
Elena (CS Ops): I'll draft the downgrade-safe path doc mapping feature equivalence + migration checklist (what to disable, what remains). Also prepare the commercial language for a short term credit.
Maya (CSM): If adoption doesn't improve within 14 days post-workshop, propose a 'grace downgrade' — pro-rated credits + onboarding voucher for the lower tier, and a timeline for re-upgrade. Keep it framed as an outcomes-first path.
Ravi (AM): ETA EOD today for the Typeform and the adoption nudges copy. I'll also create a short one-click survey to attach to post-workshop email.
Noah (Support): Reminder to capture pre/post metrics: baseline_tokens, lat95_pre, lat95_post, kv_cache_hit_rate. Will add those to the triage notes.
Elena (CS Ops): :eyes: Looping Legal if we need special contract language for the credit. I'll ping them after I draft.
Maya (CSM): Owners assigned: tech triage -> Noah; workshop -> Maya; enablement prompts & survey -> Ravi; commercial/credits -> Elena. I'll update the ACME customer record with the playbook and share a short timeline.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 24h before the event.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team — short sync after triage to decide whether to offer the 10% save or keep to enablement-first. :rocket:
